concurrent-flow and opposed-flow."},{"function":"extinction","statement":"The investigation examined putting out flames over different materials, geometries, preheating, and flow using an inert gaseous agent.","quote":"Assess the effectiveness of an inert, gaseous extinguishing agent (similar to that used on ISS) in putting out flames over different materials, geometries, preheating, and flow."},{"function":"suppression","statement":"The investigation connects nitrogen flame suppression in microgravity to spacecraft extinguishment techniques.","quote":"Using nitrogen as a flame suppressant in microgravity provides a direct link to current and planned extinguishment techniques."}],"statements":[{"statement":"The fuels included a 75% cotton and 25% fiberglass fabric, Nomex fabric, and Ultem.","quote":"Custom-made fabric samples consisting of 75% cotton and 25% fiberglass (by mass) measuring were used as a fuel source as well as Nomex fabric and Ultem."},{"statement":"Combustion was initiated with a 29-gage Kanthal wire igniter at one end of the fabric, with fan-driven airflow up to 40 cm/s.","quote":"A Kanthal wire (29-gage)igniter was used to initiate combustion at one end of the fabric. Airflow was controlled using a variable speed fan, with airflow speeds reaching as high as 40 cm/s."},{"statement":"The airflow was along the fuel surface in either opposed or concurrent direction.","quote":"The airflow was directed along the fuel surface in either the opposed or concurrent direction."},{"statement":"The recorded flame quantities included size, shape, color, spread rate, and potential quenching.","quote":"Flames were observed in the top and edge profiles and data was collected on flame size, shape, color, spread rate, and potential flame quenching."},{"statement":"Samples were tested in a 76 mm by 76 mm flow duct, and other sample shapes included spheres and cylinders.","quote":"The samples were placed in a small flow duct (76 mm x 76 mm cross section) that allowed for airflow across the fabric. Other sample shapes were utilized as well including spheres and cylinders."}]}
